integrityControls.scope: UTF-8/expression preservation, context/range/name rejection, exact release/source review binding

limitations: Original registrations remain native-build-time coverage; parallel main comparisons add deployed API observations rather than reclassifying compiler checks.
Only these twelve flat unwrapped IO sources are included. Guarded/scoped inputs and serial fuzz/hang tests still need separate verified adaptations.
Every test retains its original assertions and timeouts. Source-hidden relocation with an empty PATH is checked; this adapter does not enforce kernel source/tool denial.
Linux x64 only; no complete Std.Http, all-language/API, latest-release full suite or six-platform acceptance is implied.
